visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a white puffer jacket and grey cargo pants, walks down a brightly lit indoor hallway with light-colored tile flooring. She stops, looking distressed, and pats her pockets while white mathematical formulas appear as overlays around her head. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor food stall area with orange awnings; the woman is rummaging through a pink and white tote bag with a frustrated expression. (3) She is seen walking along a stone path in a green park environment with a boy in a brown sweatshirt; she continues searching her bag frantically. (4) A second girl with dark hair in a bun appears next to her in the park, and the woman looks surprised. (5) The boy and the second girl hold up thin, credit-card-sized metal objects (one silver, one black) labeled 'HERE 2'. (6) In a series of close-up shots, hands place the black card into a light-colored leather wallet, demonstrating its 1.3mm thickness, and then bend the card to show its flexibility against a black box background. (7) Indoors, in a room with a solar system poster, the boy holds the silver card while a small USB-C cable is plugged into it. (8) All three individuals sit on a grey sofa, gesturing toward the product and smiling at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, bright electronic pop background music starts with a clear, synthetic beat. A female voice speaks rapidly with a high-pitched, frantic tone. A sharp digital 'ding' sound effect accompanies the visual math symbols. (2) The female voice continues with rising intonation, indicating confusion. The BGM remains steady. (3) A transition occurs with a comedic 'whoosh' sound effect as a second female voice with a cheerful, clear tone begins speaking. (4) An energetic male voice joins, delivering information with high arousal and a confident, professional tone. (5) A series of quick 'pop' and 'click' sound effects are used for emphasis during the product demonstration. (6) The voices overlap in a synchronized shout for the final slogan as the music reaches its peak volume before a clean hard-cut ending.
